bio: Antonio Colosimo was baptized on 15 June 1659 at San Mango di Aquino in Calabria, the son of Antonino Colosimo and Angila Vaccaro. He married Giovanna Ierra on 11 February 1680. He was still living in March 1713 and died at San Mango di Aquino. He is John's 9th-great-grandfather.
